info.sub_name: 語料語言學及英語教學

description.sub_name: 語料語言學及英語教學
description.describe_ch: 此課程將引導研究生入門以瞭解語料、語料庫對英語教學之影響，以及在英語教學上之應用。透過論文導讀以及相關軟體應用，學生能了解最近語料在英語教學上之應用，觀念改變及研究發現。應用軟體分析，學生能看到應用各種網路關鍵字詞索引對理解英文文字語體上改變，這些對英文教與學帶來不同認識及應用，也深化英文教學。
description.describe_eh: This course intends to teach graduate students how to understand corpus applications and conduct research in English teaching and related applied linguistic fields. Students are required, on one hand, to acquire a fundamental understanding of how corpora can be used to their research. On the other hand, they need to produce a conventional research paper after a survey of relevant corpus applications in English teaching including concordancing. Concordancing can also lead students to understand how web-based corpus tools can have an impact on English teaching and learning.

targets.describe_ch: 具備語料研究及應用的知識和基本技能以合宜地使用在英文教學範疇
targets.describe_en: To acquire the knowledge and skills of recent corpus-related applications for English teaching and learning

targets.describe_ch: 具備能解讀並融合語料研究報告並使用網路工具以應用在英文教學範疇
targets.describe_en: To understand and synthesize the findings in corpus-related reports and apply corpus tools to English teaching and learning

targets.describe_ch: 具備撰寫符合學術規範之語料庫論文的能力(含文章摘要及期末報告)
targets.describe_en: To write article summaries and a review term paper on corpus-related issues that conform to the conventions in the discipline
